source_quotes.quote: Consider any pair that keeps left and replaces right with an inner position k.
Its width k - left is smaller, and its water height cannot exceed height[left], even if the new wall is much taller.
On [1, 3, 3], the outer pair gives area 2.
it misses positions 1 and 2, whose area is 3.

minimal_countercheck: 使用原文 [1,3,3]：left=0 的短牆高為1，right=2。內側 pair (1,2) 的寬為1，小於外側寬2，但其水高為3，大於短左牆高1。這反駁 every narrower pair 的廣義讀法；pair (1,2) 不保留 left。保留 left 的狹義讀法則成立。

source_quotes.quote: What happens on equal heights? Either endpoint can be removed safely. This implementation removes the left one.
Evaluate its endpoint pair before discarding anything.
It removes a wall only after proving that the lost pairs are already covered by a recorded value.
A separate tie witness, [3, 3, 3], starts with area 6, moves left, measures area 3, moves left again and returns 6.

minimal_countercheck: 原文等高 witness [3,3,3] 的外側面積6。若只滿足骨架的 equal heights，在尚未計算／保存6時先移除任一外側端點，剩下唯一 pair 面積3，先前的6已不能由該次後續搜尋取得。因此 equal heights 與相同合法輸入並未單獨保證 safe。實際程式先記錄面積，並沒有這個錯誤；這是骨架省去順序／記錄狀態的反例。
